description: Master Django's template language, inheritance, and static files

slides.title: Introduction to Templates
slides.content:
# Django Templates 📝 Create dynamic HTML pages with Django's template language! ## What you'll learn: - **Template language basics** - Variables, tags, filters - **Template inheritance** - Reusable layouts - **Static files** - CSS, JavaScript, images ## Why Use Templates? ```python # Without templates (messy, unmaintainable!) def home(request): return HttpResponse(f""" {title}

{heading}

{content}

""") # With templates (clean, maintainable!) def home(request): return render(request, 'home.html', { 'title': title, 'heading': heading, 'content': content }) ``` ## Template Location ``` myproject/ ├── templates/ # Project-wide templates │ └── base.html └── blog/ └── templates/ # App-specific templates └── blog/ # Namespace to avoid conflicts ├── list.html └── detail.html ``` > 💡 **Templates separate presentation logic from business logic!**

slides.title: Template Language Basics - Variables
slides.content:
# Template Variables 📊 ## Passing Data to Templates ```python # views.py def article_detail(request, pk): article = Article.objects.get(pk=pk) return render(request, 'article.html', { 'article': article, 'author': article.author, 'tags': ['python', 'django', 'web'], 'published': True, }) ``` ## Displaying Variables ```html

{{ article.title }}

By {{ author.name }}

{{ article.content }}

{{ user.email }} {{ article.published_date }} {{ person.name }} {{ settings.DEBUG }} {{ tags.0 }} {{ tags.1 }} ``` ## Variable Fallbacks ```html {{ name|default:"Anonymous User" }} {% if article.image %} {% else %} {% endif %} ``` > 💡 **Dot notation** works for attributes, methods, dictionary keys, and list indices!

slides.title: Template Tags - Control Flow
Template Tags - Loops
slides.content:
# For Loops 🔄 ## Basic Loop ```html
    {% for article in articles %}
  • {{ article.title }} by {{ article.author.name }}
    • {% empty %}
  • No articles found.
    • {% endfor %}
``` ## Loop Variables ```html {% for item in items %} {{ forloop.counter }} {{ forloop.counter0 }} {{ forloop.revcounter }} {{ forloop.first }} {{ forloop.last }} {{ forloop.parentloop }} {% endfor %} {% for product in products %} {% endfor %}
{{ forloop.counter }} {{ product.name }} ${{ product.price }}
``` ## URL Tag ```html Read More Home Blog Posts ```

slides.title: Template Filters
slides.content: # Template Filters 🔧 Transform variables using the pipe `|` symbol. ## Text Filters ```html {{ name|upper }} {{ name|lower }} {{ name|title }} {{ name|capfirst }} {{ text|truncatewords:30 }} {{ text|truncatechars:100 }} {{ text|wordcount }} {{ text|linebreaks }} {{ text|striptags }} ``` ## Date Filters ```html {{ article.published|date:"F j, Y" }} {{ article.published|date:"d/m/Y" }} {{ article.published|date:"D, M d" }} {{ article.published|timesince }} {{ article.published|timeuntil }} ``` ## Number Filters ```html {{ price|floatformat:2 }} {{ count|add:5 }} {{ items|length }} {{ ratio|percentage }} ``` ## List Filters ```html {{ items|first }} {{ items|last }} {{ items|join:", " }} {{ items|slice:":3" }} ``` ## Safety Filters ```html {{ html_content|safe }} {{ text|escape }} ``` > ⚠️ **Only use `|safe` with trusted content!** It can cause XSS vulnerabilities.

slides.title: Template Inheritance
slides.content:
# Template Inheritance 🏗️ Create reusable layouts with base templates! ## Base Template (Parent) ```html {% block title %}My Site{% endblock %} {% block extra_css %}{% endblock %}
Home About Contact
{% block content %} {% endblock %}

© 2024 My Site. All rights reserved.

{% block extra_js %}{% endblock %} ``` ## Child Template ```html {% extends 'base.html' %} {% block title %}Home - My Site{% endblock %} {% block content %}

Welcome to My Blog!

This content replaces the content block in base.html

{% for post in posts %}

{{ post.title }}

{{ post.excerpt }}

{% endfor %} {% endblock %} ``` > 💡 **DRY Principle:** Define your layout once in base.html, reuse everywhere!

slides.title: Including Partial Templates
slides.content:
# Include and Block Tags 📦 ## Including Partial Templates ```html
Home About {% if user.is_authenticated %} {{ user.username }} Logout {% else %} Login {% endif %}
``` ```html {% include 'includes/navbar.html' %} {% block content %}{% endblock %} {% include 'includes/footer.html' %} ``` ## Include with Variables ```html {% include 'includes/card.html' with title=article.title image=article.image %} {% include 'includes/card.html' with title="Hello" only %} ``` ## Block Super (Keep Parent Content) ```html {% block sidebar %}

Default Sidebar

  • Link 1
  • Link 2
{% endblock %} {% block sidebar %} {{ block.super }}

Additional Content

This is added to the sidebar

{% endblock %} ``` > 🎯 **Use `include` for reusable components** like cards, modals, and alerts!

slides.title: Static Files - Configuration
slides.content:
# Static Files 📁 (Part 1)

Serve CSS, JavaScript, and images in Django.

## Configure Static Files

```python
# settings.py

# URL prefix for static files
STATIC_URL = '/static/'

# Additional directories to look for static files
STATICFILES_DIRS = [
    BASE_DIR / 'static',  # Project-wide static files
]

# Where collectstatic gathers files (for production)
STATIC_ROOT = BASE_DIR / 'staticfiles'

# Media files (user uploads)
MEDIA_URL = '/media/'
MEDIA_ROOT = BASE_DIR / 'media'
```

## Directory Structure

```
myproject/
├── static/                 # Project-wide static files
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── style.css
│   ├── js/
│   │   └── main.js
│   └── images/
│       └── logo.png
├── blog/
│   └── static/             # App-specific static files
│       └── blog/           # Namespace to avoid conflicts
│           ├── css/
│           │   └── blog.css
│           └── js/
│               └── blog.js
└── templates/
```

> 💡 **Always namespace app static files** (blog/static/blog/) to prevent file name conflicts between apps!

slides.title: Static Files - Usage
slides.content: # Static Files 📁 (Part 2) ## Using Static Files in Templates ```html {% load static %} My Site ``` ## In Base Template ```html {% load static %} {% block extra_css %}{% endblock %} {% block content %}{% endblock %} {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %} ``` ## Production Deployment ```bash # Collect all static files into STATIC_ROOT python manage.py collectstatic # This copies all static files to one location # for your web server (Nginx, Apache) to serve ``` > ⚠️ **Don't forget `{% load static %}` at the top of your template!**

slides.title: Summary
slides.content:
# Excellent Work! 🎉

You've mastered Django Templates!

## Template Language Basics
- ✅ Variables: `{{ variable }}`
- ✅ Tags: `{% tag %}`
- ✅ Filters: `{{ var|filter }}`
- ✅ Comments: `{# comment #}`

## Control Flow
- ✅ `{% if %}` / `{% elif %}` / `{% else %}` / `{% endif %}`
- ✅ `{% for %}` loops with `{% empty %}`
- ✅ Loop variables (`forloop.counter`, etc.)

## Template Inheritance
- ✅ `{% extends 'base.html' %}`
- ✅ `{% block name %}` ... `{% endblock %}`
- ✅ `{% include 'partial.html' %}`
- ✅ `{{ block.super }}` to keep parent content

## Filters
- ✅ Text: `upper`, `lower`, `title`, `truncatewords`
- ✅ Dates: `date`, `timesince`
- ✅ Lists: `length`, `first`, `join`
- ✅ Safety: `safe`, `escape`

## Static Files
- ✅ `{% load static %}` at template top
- ✅ `{% static 'path/to/file' %}` to reference files
- ✅ Configure `STATIC_URL` and `STATICFILES_DIRS`
- ✅ Namespace app static files

> 🚀 **Next Steps:** Learn about Models to work with databases!
